articles.summary: Santiago, Chile, October 2, 2026 LATAM Airlines Group S.A. (LATAM or the Company) (SSE: LTM / NYSE: LTM) along with its consolidated affiliates (LATAM group), the leading airline group in Latin America, announces that it will release its financial results for the third quarter 2026 on November 3, 2026, following the market close. The release will be available on the Companys Investor Relations website: ir.latam.com . The Company will hold a conference call to discuss the third quarter 2026 financial results on November 4, 2026, at 8:00 am ET / 9:00 am Santiago. Adhering to good corporate governance practices, the Company will begin its quiet period on October 20, 2026, ending immediately after the release of the financial results on November 3, 2026.
